title: Solidity Examples
description: Each example belongs to one starter lesson. Follow its setup steps before trying it. These examples need the named tools and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: Return a greeting
examples.description: A contract groups functions and data. Call message() to read a greeting without changing stored data.

examples.title: Return a whole number
examples.description: uint256 stores a nonnegative whole number. Call answer() to add two small counts.

examples.title: Read stored state
examples.description: A state variable lives in contract storage. public creates a getter. Call score().

examples.title: Use a function input
examples.description: A parameter is an input value. Call twice(4) in Remix.

examples.title: Choose a message
examples.description: if selects a result based on a rule. Call message(8).

examples.title: Read an array item
examples.description: A memory array is temporary data for the call. Call answer() to read its second item.

examples.title: Add values in a loop
examples.description: A for loop repeats steps. Call answer() to add 1, 2 and 3.

examples.title: Name a fixed choice
examples.description: An enum names a small set of choices. Call answer() to read the chosen case number.

examples.title: Group fields
examples.description: A struct groups related fields. Call answer() to read a book page count.

examples.title: Read a mapping value
examples.description: A mapping pairs keys with values. Unset integer keys return zero. Call scoreOf(1).

examples.title: Reject an invalid input
examples.description: require stops a call when its rule is false. Call check(0) to see the error.

examples.title: Read state without changing it
examples.description: view allows reading contract state. Call doubled() to read twice the stored score.
